descriptions.NEV: An ordinary mole. Very common and usually harmless.
descriptions.SEK: A benign, warty growth that becomes more common with age. Harmless.
descriptions.ACK: A rough, sun-damaged patch. Pre-cancerous — it can develop into a skin cancer if untreated.
descriptions.BCC: The most common skin cancer. Grows slowly and rarely spreads, but needs treating.
descriptions.SCC: A skin cancer that can spread if left untreated. Needs prompt assessment.
descriptions.MEL: The most serious skin cancer. Early treatment matters a great deal.

recommendations.Low: Keep monitoring. Re-photograph this lesion in about 3 months and compare.
recommendations.Moderate: Book a non-urgent appointment with a doctor or dermatologist to have this lesion checked.
recommendations.High: See a dermatologist promptly. Do not wait for it to change further.
